blocks.heading: Student Success and Early Warning Systems

Graduation risk prediction: Multi-year graduation probability prediction for high school students, incorporating academic, attendance, behavior, and social support signals into actionable risk tiers for counselor caseload prioritization.
Reading intervention identification: Early reading deficiency prediction from assessment data enabling targeted reading intervention placement in early elementary grades.
FERPA-compliant data handling standard — student data in educational AI is protected under FERPA and IL Student Data Privacy Act.
Cost: $40,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks

sections.title: Illinois Education Data Privacy Context
sections.description: Compliance frameworks embedded in every Chicago education AI project.

blocks.heading: FERPA
paragraphs: Federal Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act protects student educational records — all ClickMasters Chicago education AI is designed with FERPA's requirements for data access, use limitation, and disclosure consent.

blocks.heading: Illinois Student Data Privacy Act (SDPA)
paragraphs: Illinois's student data privacy law (2015) restricts how student data can be used and shared by educational technology companies — ClickMasters designs Chicago K-12 EdTech AI with SDPA requirements in mind.

blocks.heading: COPPA
paragraphs: Children's Online Privacy Protection Act applies to online educational services serving children under 13 — ClickMasters designs Chicago K-12 educational AI with COPPA compliance where student age requires it.

blocks.heading: Chicago Public Schools Procurement
paragraphs: CPS procurement processes have specific requirements for student data privacy and technology vendor approval. ClickMasters provides the technical documentation and data governance evidence that CPS procurement processes require.
